# cycle_scoped_variable (Data Source)

Looks up a Cycle scoped variable in an environment by ID or identifier. Exactly one of `id` or `identifier` must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a scoped variable by identifier in an environment.
data "cycle_scoped_variable" "api_token" {
  environment_id = cycle_environment.api.id
  identifier     = "API_TOKEN"
}

# Or by its ID.
data "cycle_scoped_variable" "by_id" {
  environment_id = cycle_environment.api.id
  id             = "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21"
}

output "api_token_key" {
  value = try(data.cycle_scoped_variable.api_token.access.env_variable.key, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment this scoped variable belongs to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the scoped variable. Exactly one of `id` or `identifier` must be set.
- `identifier` (String) The identifier of the scoped variable, similar to the key of an environment variable. Exactly one of `id` or `identifier` must be set. Identifiers are not guaranteed unique; the lookup fails if multiple live variables match.

### Read-Only

- `access` (Attributes) How the scoped variable is exposed to containers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access))
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this scoped variable belongs to.
- `scope` (Attributes) Which containers in the environment the variable is assigned to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope))
- `secret` (Attributes) Present when the variable is marked as a secret on the Cycle dashboard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secret))
- `state` (String) The current state of the scoped variable.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The raw value of the scoped variable, when the API returns a raw source.

<a id="nestedatt--access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access`

Read-Only:

- `env_variable` (Attributes) Present when the variable is exposed as a container environment variable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access--env_variable))
- `file` (Attributes) Present when the variable is mounted as a file inside the container. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access--file))
- `internal_api` (Attributes) Present when the variable is exposed over Cycle's internal API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access--internal_api))

<a id="nestedatt--access--env_variable"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access.env_variable`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The environment variable name set on the target container.


<a id="nestedatt--access--file"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access.file`

Read-Only:

- `decode` (Boolean) Whether Cycle base64-decodes the value before writing the file.
- `path` (String) The path the file is mounted to inside the container.


<a id="nestedatt--access--internal_api"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access.internal_api`

Read-Only:

- `duration` (String) How long the internal API serves the variable after runtime start.



<a id="nestedatt--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope`

Read-Only:

- `container_identifiers` (List of String) Container identifiers that have access to this scoped variable.
- `container_ids` (List of String) Container IDs that have access to this scoped variable.
- `global` (Boolean) Whether the variable is assigned to all current and future containers in the environment.


<a id="nestedatt--secret"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secret`

Read-Only:

- `hint` (String) A user-specified hint for portal-encrypted values.
- `iv` (String) The IV hex associated with portal-side encryption, if any.
